lines.en: I hang beneath a forest leaf.
Wind moves through the trunks, and I rock.
My cocoon is lighter than the leaf.
I hang on the shaded side.
Time passes slowly here.
Damp rises from the bark.
I drift with the branch's shadow.
The silk holds me fast.
I can't see how far down it goes.
The wood stays dim all day.
My casing is thinning, slowly.

lines.zh: 我等一个月色好的夜晚
lines.en: I'm waiting for a night with a good moon.
The smell of sap never leaves.
I barely move. I only wait.
A squirrel leaps overhead.
Wrapped in silk, I look like a dead leaf.
I hang quietly, like a dead leaf.
A hint of green shows through the case.
Inside, I turn slowly.
Birds call far off in the wood.
Dew settles on my case.
I hear insects crawling on the bark.
My wings are folded inside.
This moment is very quiet.
There's nowhere else for me to be.
The forest's shadow has covered me.
I wait for that bit of light at night.

lines.zh: 树在风里响，我在响里睡
lines.en: The tree sounds in the wind, and I sleep in it.
You look up at me from below.

lines.zh: 你把我当成了一颗果子
lines.en: You took me for a piece of fruit.
I can't come down. Don't shake the tree.

lines.zh: 你的火把把这里照亮了
lines.en: Your torch has lit this place.
I'm inside the cocoon, and can't see well.

lines.zh: 你手指的温度传上来了
lines.en: The warmth of your fingers reaches me.
In some days I'll come out.
You wait, and so do I.
Don't take this for a dead thing.
There's life inside me.
The cocoon has a dent.
The cocoon rocks hard and the leaf rustles.
Something inside has been jarred.
The silk grinds and creaks.
I can't flee, and can't hide.
The case has gone a little soft.
I shrink as small as I can.

lines.zh: 我这层薄茧，经不起第二下。
lines.en: This thin casing will not take a second blow.
The thin shell cracks; I curl up tighter.
Back off; I still have to molt.
I don't eat inside the cocoon.

lines.zh: 你把叶子递上来也没用
lines.en: Holding a leaf up won't help.
At this stage I only wait.
I can smell it.
I've no mouth to eat with.
Hang it on a branch instead.
When I'm out — perhaps then.
Right now I need nothing.
Keep it. Don't waste it.
My wings matter more than food.
The tree shakes and I hit the bark.
I didn't fall. The silk holds.
Your hand touched the cocoon.
The case is slightly dented.
Inside, I'm swinging hard.
You step back, and I slowly settle.
That much contact I can bear.

lines.zh: 被撞得转了半圈，丝还挂着。
lines.en: Knocked half a turn around, still hanging by the silk.
Don't poke me with that stick.
Hung under a leaf, I sway in the wind.
I'm in a cocoon. Not now.
There are other cocoons on this tree.
When I emerge, my wings will speak.
We'll meet on a night with a good moon.
Are you waiting here too?
One branch lies between us.
No hurry. The season is long.
We'll speak of it then.
I will come out when the moonlight is bright enough.
Don't disturb me. Thank you.

lines.zh: 我够不到任何东西，茧挂在树上。
lines.en: I cannot reach anything; the cocoon hangs in the tree.

lines.zh: 挂在枝上，我什么都拿不了
lines.en: Hanging here, I can't take a thing.
A luna cocoon hangs in the forest.

lines.zh: 你放在枝上，我就看得见
lines.en: Set it on the branch and I'll see it.
Don't hang it on the silk.
Too heavy; it would pull me down.

lines.zh: 我的丝缠在枝上，解不开。
lines.en: My silk is wound around the twig, unyielding.
Come find me after I'm out.
Put nothing here for now.
Keep it.
Something's moving below the tree.
The firelight shifted.
I can't tell what it is.
It has stopped right beneath me.
My case is close to the bark's color.
I keep still. As still as I can.
It's looking up.
I hope it hasn't seen.
It's begun shaking the tree.
I cling to the silk.
It's still down there.
The tree shakes harder and harder.
The silk makes a thin creak.
I try not to swing.
It's reaching up with a stick.
The stick is very near me.
All I can do is stay motionless.
It's touched the leaf.
The leaf is pushed aside.
And so I'm exposed.
I can't so much as stir.
The case is my only shield.
A touch is pain to me.
I tighten everything I have.
A mark is left on the case.
I sway, to show I'm still here.
The stick has withdrawn.
The tree has stopped shaking.
I'm still hanging where I was.
I've outlasted it.

lines.zh: 我在森林的叶下结成茧
lines.en: I made this cocoon under a forest leaf.
The last loop of silk is wound.
The tree's shadow hides me.
The green outside has gone blurry.
I give myself over to time.

lines.zh: 第一层丝已经绕住叶柄。
lines.en: The first thread is already wound round the leaf stalk.
This branch is sturdy enough.
Insects chirr in the bark.
I begin to change inside.
I'll know when the moon rises.
The heat makes the cocoon brittle.
The cocoon and I fell together.
Water seeps in; I'm suffocating.
The blast tears the cocoon off the branch.
Something sharp pierced the cocoon.
This force heats the cocoon.
In the cocoon I don't feed anyway.
Lightning lights the whole wood.
The branch is gone, and I fall with it.
